title: Delta10 is named as a Common Ground platform supplier but its depth is unverified
content:
Delta10 appears in the Benelux supplier sweep as a Common Ground platform supplier, and that is the whole of what the record establishes. Being named against Common Ground components puts the firm in the right ecosystem; nothing in the assessment says how deep the involvement runs, whether it builds components or assembles them, or what it has shipped.

The honest reading is a placeholder with a verified category and no verified substance, which is why it sits at priority 3. It is on the list so the name is not lost, not because it has been qualified.
